audit.whatIsWrong: The level chart gives Level 6 to Karma and phases[4].why justifies it with "Karma's ultimate changes the math too".
audit.why: Riot's own text on Mantra: "Mantra is available at level 1 and does not require a skill point." Karma has no level-6 spike at all, while Yone gains Fate Sealed (120/100/80s). Level 6 is a one-sided swing to Yone and the packet chart also has Yone from row 4 on.
audit.corrected: Flipped Level 6 to Yone on BOTH layers (phases[4].side + win[4]) and rewrote phases[4].why to state that Mantra is up from level 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[1].text called level 6 a non-spike for both and credited "Cleave sustain"; breakdown.late described Fate Sealed with no cooldown.
audit.why: Spirit Cleave grants a SHIELD, not sustain (Riot text: "Grants a shield to Yone"). Fate Sealed is 120/100/80s and Mantra is 40/38/36/34s — those two numbers are what decide when to commit at 6.
audit.corrected: Rewrote spikes[1].text around Fate Sealed 120s vs Mantra 40s, replaced 'sustain' with the shield everywhere it appeared, and put the ult cooldown into breakdown.late.

audit.whatIsWrong: Vague 'his answer' / 'her answer' phrasing instead of naming the interaction, plus Karma referred to as 'he' in five fields.
audit.why: Focused Resolve is a flat 12s at every rank — that is the concrete window Yone trades into. Naming it and the number is the whole advice. Karma is female; the page used male pronouns.
audit.corrected: Named Focused Resolve and its 12s cooldown in tradeGood/tradeBad/breakdown.trading/breakdown.mid, named Soul Unbound instead of 'the soul timer', and fixed the pronouns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page mentions Grievous Wounds despite Mantra-empowered Focused Resolve healing Karma.
audit.why: Riot's W text: "Mantra Bonus: Karma strengthens the link, healing herself and extending the root duration." Extended trades are decided by that heal.
audit.corrected: Added the anti-heal timing to breakdown.mid.

edits.before: Fate Sealed sets up team knockups nothing can dodge. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Karma's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Fate Sealed blinks behind her and drags her back in. Mantra is up from level 1, so 6 shifts nothing for her and everything for you.

edits.before: Fate Sealed sets up team knockups nothing can dodge — build your teamfight around that. Karma carry threat: 6/10 — shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Fate Sealed pulls the line together on a 120/100/80s cooldown — build your teamfight around it. Karma carry threat: 6/10 — shift to picks and wave control if she gets ahead.

edits.after: Stack to Q3, E in while Focused Resolve is on its 12s cooldown, dump Q3-W-AA, snap back before she re-tethers.

edits.after: Good trade: Stack to Q3, E in while Focused Resolve is on its 12s cooldown, dump Q3-W-AA, snap back before she re-tethers. Great trade: Karma wastes Focused Resolve — commit the full pattern immediately. Bad trade: E-ing in while Focused Resolve is up, or overstaying Soul Unbound — the spot you snap back to is where Yones die.

edits.before: Trade strictly around Focused Resolve: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If behind, farm safe and let your spikes re-open the lane.
edits.after: Trade around Focused Resolve's 12s cooldown: when it is down, run your full pattern. Mantra-W heals her through chip, so buy Grievous Wounds before you try to grind her out.

edits.before: Neither of you spikes hard on level, but Yone's kit only compounds — your R (Fate Sealed) plus Cleave sustain shrug off her poke while she has no reliable escape from your dash. Force the all-in when her RQ is on cooldown.
edits.after: Level 6 is yours: Fate Sealed (120s at rank 1) blinks past her and drags her back, and Spirit Cleave's shield eats her Inner Flame chip. Mantra is up from level 1, so force the all-in while it sits on its 40s cooldown, not into a fresh RQ.

edits.before: From level 4 onward Yone takes over — your Q3 dash and E close past her shields faster than Mantra comes back, and Cleave sustain heals off her poke. Wait for her to spend RQ, then commit; her only answer is a flash she rarely keeps up.
edits.after: From level 4 onward Yone takes over — your Q3 dash and Soul Unbound close past her shields faster than Mantra's 40s comes back, and Spirit Cleave's shield eats her poke. Wait for her to spend RQ, then commit; her only answer is a flash she rarely keeps up.

notes: Yone's W is a SHIELD, not sustain — two content fields described it as healing and are corrected. Karma was referred to as 'he' in five full-layer fields. Whether Focused Resolve's tether breaks on range or on line-of-sight is NOT in Riot's text (it only says 'if the tether is not broken'), so I left the existing 'LoS / outrange it' wording alone rather than sharpen it.
